verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents first-party natural-language analytics. Conversational analytics lets users "have natural language conversations with your data" and has been extended to market basket questions. Gemini in BigQuery can find, join, query and visualize table assets from natural language, and data insights generates queries from table metadata. Nothing in the evidence shows these answers are grounded in a governed semantic layer or protected against wrong joins; IAM roles exist but are not tied to the NL experience. missing for 10: semantic-layer/metric grounding for NL answers, documented safeguards against incorrect joins, governance enforcement specific to conversational analytics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
